kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/baser.create_BaseReload: create a uvicorn reloader instance with BaseReload using a Config, target callable, and list of sockets
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/baser.run_BaseReload: run the uvicorn BaseReload reloader loop that detects file changes and restarts the subprocess
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/baser.review_BaseReload_startup: review the BaseReload startup method that registers signal handlers and spawns the child subprocess
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/baser.refactor_BaseReload_restart: refactor the BaseReload restart method to terminate and restart the child process on file changes
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/baser.summarize_BaseReload_shutdown: summarize the BaseReload shutdown method that terminates the subprocess and closes sockets

kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/multi.run_multiprocess_server: run uvicorn with multiple worker processes using the Multiprocess class and config
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/multi.create_process_instance: create a Process instance to manage a single uvicorn worker subprocess with sockets
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/multi.test_process_health: test if a uvicorn worker process is alive by sending ping and checking pong response
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/multi.review_signal_handlers: review Multiprocess signal handlers for SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGHUP, SIGTTIN, and SIGTTOU
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/multi.summarize_process_lifecycle: summarize the process lifecycle including start, terminate, kill, and join operations

kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/statr.build_statreload_reloader: build a StatReload instance that watches Python files and restarts uvicorn on changes
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/statr.create_statreload_check_restart: create a StatReload instance and check if any Python file has been modified since last check
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/statr.test_statreload_iter_py_files: test the StatReload iter_py_files method to yield all Python files in reload directories
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/statr.review_statrestart_restart: review the StatReload restart method that clears mtimes cache and triggers a parent restart
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/statr.summarize_statreload_should_restart: summarize the StatReload should_restart method that detects file modifications via mtime comparison

kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/watch.create_FileFilter: create a FileFilter instance that filters file paths based on uvicorn config include and exclude patterns
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/watch.run_WatchFilesReload: run a WatchFilesReload reloader that monitors directories for file changes and triggers restarts
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/watch.review_FileFilter_call: review the FileFilter.__call__ method that returns True if a path matches include patterns and not exclude patterns
kludex_uvicorn/uvicorn/supervisors/watch.review_WatchFilesReload_should_restart: review the WatchFilesReload.should_restart method that checks for file changes and returns filtered paths
